title: Fantasy Player News
description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Bell (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Bell (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was limited to start the practice week on Wednesday due to a knee issue. It seems unlikely to affect his availability for Week 4, however, and he seems primed to see more work against the Vikings with Caleb Douglas (ankle) trending towards missing another game for Miami.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Blake Cashman (elbow) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Blake Cashman (elbow) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cashman is now dealing with an elbow injury of some kind and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. He seems likely to play through it in Week 4, but we won't know his status for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Justin Jefferson (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Justin Jefferson (ankle) did not take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Jefferson suffered an ankle injury in Week 3 and was not able to practice on Wednesday as a result. He will reportedly have a chance to play in Week 4, so fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see whether or not that will be the case.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Jackson Powers-Johnson (groin) missed Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The Raiders may be without their starting guard in Week 4. Powers-Johnson is currently dealing with a groin issue and was unable to practice on Wednesday as a result. His absence would be less than ideal this week ahead of a tough matchup against Kansas City's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chamarri Conner (knee) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Chamarri Conner (knee) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Conner was sidelined due to a knee injury in Week 3, but it looks like he's about ready to make his return to the lineup this week, as he was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday. Kansas City's defense will see a nice boost if he's back in the lineup against the Raiders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: L'Jarius Sneed (knee) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Sneed was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, as he is currently managing a lingering knee issue of some kind. He should be available to play in Week 4, however, assuming he doesn't suffer a setback throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Ingram (groin) logs limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ed Ingram (groin) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined last week due to a groin injury of some kind, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday and seems to have a chance to make his return in Week 4. That would be great news for Houston's offensive front ahead of a matchup against Dallas this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Trent Brown (illness/knee/wrist) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was not able to practice for the Texans on Wednesday. His main issue seems to be an illness right now, as he played through his other two listed injuries last week. He seems likely to play in Week 4, which is good news for Houston's offense ahead of a matchup against the Cowboys.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Will Anderson Jr. (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Anderson was left limited at Wednesday's practice due to an ankle injury that he's managing. It doesn't seem like a major issue at this point, however, and it seems unlikely to leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nico Collins (hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nico Collins (hamstring) was limited at Houston's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The star wideout was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. He has been sidelined for the last two games due to a nagging hamstring injury, but he seems to be trending towards making his return to the lineup in Week 4. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week if he's cleared to play heading into the weekend.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Drake Maye (shoulder) practices in full Wednesday
items.desc: Drake Maye (shoulder) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
items.impact: Maye is featured on New England's injury report to start the week. He's managing a minor shoulder injury right now, but he told reporters that it hasn't affected his throwing up to this point. Fantasy managers shouldn't be starting him this week, even if he wasn't on the injury report in any capacity.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was sidelined last week due to a shoulder injury, but it looks like he will have a chance to make his return to the lineup in Week 4, as he was limited at practice to start the week on Wednesday. His return would be significant for New England's defense, as he is currently their top pass rusher.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Barmore (shoulder) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Barmore (shoulder) missed New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The big man is currently battling a shoulder injury and wasn't able to practice on Wednesday as a result. If it causes him to miss any time, that will be bad news for a New England defense that struggled to get a stop last week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Craig Woodson (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Craig Woodson (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Woodson missed last week's game due to a shoulder injury, but he was able to participate in Wednesday's practice and seems to be trending the right way for Week 4. His presence will be important in New England's secondary this week ahead of a tough matchup against the Bills.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Christian Gonzalez (shoulder) did not take part in New England's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Gonzalez is a new addition to New England's injury report, being listed with a shoulder injury that left him sidelined at practice on Wednesday. This could just be a load management move from the team early on in the week, but if it's a real issue for the star cornerback, that will be bad timing ahead of a very difficult matchup against Josh Allen and the Bills this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Eli Raridon (thigh) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Eli Raridon (thigh) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie missed last week's game due to a thigh issue, and he starts out this week limited at practice due to the same issue. It could leave him sidelined again in Week 4, but we won't know his official status until sometime later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ed Oliver (hip) off injury report for Week 4
items.desc: Ed Oliver (hip) is off of Buffalo's injury report heading into Week 4.
items.impact: Oliver suffered a hip injury and missed a bit of time because of it, but he is now off of the injury report entirely and will be good to go in Week 4. He will continue to play a big role on Buffalo's defense moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: DJ Moore (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: DJ Moore (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore was left limited at Wednesday's practice due to a nagging shoulder issue that has been bothering him for multiple weeks. This seems to just be an injury management move on the part of the team, however, so fantasy managers should expect him to play in Week 4 at this point.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Keon Coleman (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Keon Coleman (ankle) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Coleman is a new addition to Buffalo's injury report, being listed with an ankle issue that left him sidelined at practice on Wednesday. It could affect his availability for Week 4, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josh Allen without injury designation for Week 4
items.desc: Josh Allen is without an injury designation ahead of Week 4's matchup against the New England Patriots.
items.impact: There was some concern that Allen suffered a minor injury of some kind in last week's win over the Chargers, but that's not the case and he carries no injury designation heading into Week 4. He should be a full go and remains a top-tier fantasy option moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Christian Watson good to go for Week 4
items.desc: Christian Watson carries no injury designation and will be good to go for Week 4's matchup against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
items.impact: There was some public concern when Watson seemed to favor one of his legs towards the end of last Thursday's game, but he is not listed on Green Bay's injury report for Week 4 and should be a full go against the Buccaneers. He remains a must-start fantasy option as often as he is healthy and on the field moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) limited Wednesday
items.desc: Lukas Van Ness (shoulder) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Ness is now dealing with a shoulder injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. He seems likely to play through it in Week 4, however, which is good news for the Packers ahead of a favorable matchup against the Buccaneers this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Banks (knee/toe) was sidelined at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Banks has already been sidelined for most of the season due to injury, and he's not trending the right way for Week 4 either. He's still dealing with a couple of different injuries and may miss another game as a result. Green Bay's offensive line has really struggled to start the year, and another absence from the veteran wouldn't help them to turn that around this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) logs limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Josiah Trotter (shoulder) logged a limited practice session on Wednesday.
items.impact: The rookie was able to log a limited practice session on Wednesday after missing last week's game due to a shoulder injury. He may be able to make his return to the lineup in Week 4, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Yaya Diaby (calf/shoulder) officially DNP Wednesday
items.desc: Yaya Diaby (calf/shoulder) officially didn't practice for the Bucs on Wednesday.
items.impact: Diaby didn't start of the week right, missing Wednesday's practice due to a couple of different injuries that he's managing. It remains to be seen what his status will be for Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Rueben Bain Jr. (groin/shoulder) missed Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Bain was sidelined in Week 3 due to injury, and he remained sidelined at practice on Wednesday due to a pair of injuries that he's dealing with. Tampa Bay's defense will be weaker than usual if he's sidelined for another game this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ko Kieft (elbow) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Ko Kieft (elbow) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was not able to take part in Wednesday's practice. He's managing an elbow injury right now, and it's unclear if it will threaten his availability for Week 4. Either way he remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Godwin Jr. (ankle) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Godwin Jr. (ankle) did not take part in Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Godwin missed the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's dealing with an ankle issue of some kind right now, and the team wants to be careful managing his workload early in the week as a result. Look for rookie Ted Hurst III to see more work in the off-chance that the veteran has to miss any time.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Bucky Irving (glute) limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Bucky Irving (glute) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Irving finds himself on the injury report after Tampa Bay's loss to the Vikings in Week 3. He's dealing with a glute injury right now, but he was still able to practice in a limited fashion, which is a good indication that it's not a serious issue. Still, fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) will log limited practice Wednesday
items.desc: Kamren Kinchens (hamstring) will log a limited practice session on Wednesday,
items.impact: Kinchens is going to be limited in Wednesday's practice after missing a couple of games due to a nagging hamstring injury. It seems like he's nearing a return to the lineup, and whenever that comes, that will bring a nice boost for Los Angeles' secondary moving forward.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Aaron Donald (back) won't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Aaron Donald (back) won't take part in Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Los Angeles' star defensive tackle is going to be absent from practice on Wednesday. He's dealing with a case of back soreness right now, but it doesn't seem to be more than a minor issue. It remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Puka Nacua (groin) to be limited at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Puka Nacua (groin) will be a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Nacua is going to return to practice on Wednesday after missing two-straight games due to a groin injury. This is a step in the right direction for his Week 4 availability, but we won't get an official status for him until later on in the week. Fantasy managers should continue to keep close tabs on any and all updates about his health.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ronnie Stanley (toe) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Ronnie Stanley (toe) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Stanley missed last week's game due to a toe issue, but he was back at practice in a limited capacity on Wednesday. He seems to be trending the right way for Week 4, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: John Simpson (groin) limited Wednesday
items.desc: John Simpson (groin) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran was limited for Wednesday's practice due to a lingering groin issue, but it isn't likely to affect his availability moving forward. If he and Ronnie Stanley (toe) are cleared to play this week, Baltimore's offensive front will be near full strength ahead of a favorable matchup against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Lamar Jackson dealing with back issue
items.desc: Lamar Jackson was limited at practice on Wednesday due to a back issue.
items.impact: We now know what left Jackson limited at practice on Wednesday. He's dealing with some kind of a back injury, but it doesn't seem to be too serious of an issue at this point. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see if it will affect him in Week 4 or not, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Chris Moore (ankle) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Chris Moore (ankle) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Moore is currently included on Baltimore's injury report due to an ankle injury, but it doesn't seem likely to leave him sidelined in Week 4. Fantasy managers still shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Marlon Humphrey (hamstring) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Humphrey is a new addition to Baltimore's injury report, being listed with a hamstring injury that left him limited at practice. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 4, however, which is good news for Baltimore's defense.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Zay Flowers (hamstring) officially limited Wednesday
items.desc: Zay Flowers (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Flowers has been dealing with a hamstring injury for a couple of weeks now, but he was able to participate in the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday, so it looks likely that he will be close to full health in Week 4. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week if he's cleared to play against the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Tyrone Tracy Jr. (knee) was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: A knee injury left Tracy sidelined at practice on Wednesday. It's still early in the week, so if he returns to practice on Thursday, fantasy managers should expect him to play and see his usual minimal workload in Week 4.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Deonte Banks (calf) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Deonte Banks (calf) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Banks has been sidelined for a couple of weeks due to his calf injury, but it looks like he will have a real chance to return in Week 3, as he starts out the week as a limited participant. His return would be a significant boost for New York's secondary against the Cardinals this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Andrew Thomas (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
items.desc: Andrew Thomas (groin) did not take part in New York's practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Thomas was sidelined at practice on Wednesday due to his groin injury, but he was able to play through it in Week 3, which indicates that it's not a serious issue at this point. He should play in Week 4 barring an unforeseen setback.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Robert Hainsey (elbow/groin) off injury report for Week 4
items.desc: Robert Hainsey (elbow/groin) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
items.impact: Hainsey was previously dealing with a pair of injuries that left him on the injury report, but he has since been removed and will be good to go for Week 4. Jacksonville's offensive line looks like it will be fully healthy in a matchup against the Bengals this week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Cole Van Lanen (knee) considered limited Wednesday
items.desc: Cole Van Lanen (knee) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Van Lanen has been dealing with this knee issue for a while, so it's no surprise that he was again limited at practice on Wednesday. He has been playing through it recently and seems likely to do so again in Week 4, however, which is good news for Jacksonville.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) limited participant Wednesday
items.desc: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran wideout is again listed with thumb injury that left him limited at practice on Wednesday, but it's not a serious issue and shouldn't prevent him from playing in Week 4. He doesn't project to be a reliable week-to-week fantasy option at this point in the season, however.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) listed as limited Wednesday
items.desc: LeQuint Allen Jr. (hip) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: As usual, Allen was listed as a limited participant on Wednesday due to a hip issue. He should be good to go for Week 4, however, assuming he suffers no setbacks with his recovery throughout the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Tony Pollard (foot) officially a non-participant Wednesday
items.desc: Tony Pollard (foot) was officially a non-participant at practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: We knew earlier in the day that Pollard wasn't going to practice, but it turns out that he is listed with a foot injury rather than an ankle issue. Fantasy managers should continue to monitor his status throughout the week, especially with Tyjae Spears (ankle) also not practicing for the Titans.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Ashton Dulin (ankle) sidelined at practice Wednesday
items.desc: Ashton Dulin (ankle) was sidelined at Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: To no surprise, Dulin was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday. He has been sidelined for multiple weeks due to a knee injury, and all signs point to him missing another game in Week 4 because of it. His likely absence may lead to more work for Laquon Treadwell against the Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Mo Alie-Cox (illness) misses practice Wednesday
items.desc: Mo Alie-Cox (illness) missed Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: The veteran tight end was unable to practice on Wednesday due to an illness. He's likely considered day-to-day for the time being, but there's a good chance that he'll be cleared to play in time for Sunday morning's game against the Washington Commanders.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Nick Cross (illness) absent from practice Wednesday
items.desc: Nick Cross (illness) was absent from practice on Wednesday.
items.impact: Cross was sidelined in Week 3 due to an illness, and he was unable to practice on Wednesday for the same reason. It could threaten his availability for Week 4, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

items.author: Leo Sells
items.title: Jaylin Lane (groin) off injury report for Week 4
items.desc: Jaylin Lane (groin) is off of the injury report for Week 4's game against the Indianapolis Colts.
items.impact: Lane is going to be good to go for Week 4 after being entirely removed from Washington's injury report. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward, however.
